chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: Kuehl's questions about later Carnegie Hall concerts
summary: Kuehl asks about a 1948 midnight concert and the 1954 Birdland Stars concerts with Sarah Vaughan and Billie; Basie does not remember them.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Yeah, I have some questions, I just remembered. Do you remember that -- oh, no -- yeah, right. You know, the midnight jazz concert in 1948, right after -- that was right after they came out -- all this -- right, because she came out in March. And you did this midnight jazz concert for the Pittsburgh Courier. I think Sarah Vaughan was on it. I think --
Oh, yeah, wait. In 1954, you did Birdland Stars of '54 Concert, two concerts at Carnegie, 8:30 and
midnight, with Sarah and Billie. Uh-huh. You don't remember the two of them together?
